stories.title: Lok Sabha passes bill creating oversight commission for 16 tribunals
stories.summary: The Lok Sabha passed the Tribunals Reforms Bill, 2026, without debate amid opposition sloganeering. It would create a National Tribunals Commission to oversee appointments, performance, complaints and a case-data grid across 16 bodies. The government says tribunal jurisdictions would remain unchanged; the proposal would replace a 2021 law partly struck down over judicial-independence concerns.
